source: Read-only Supabase and PostgreSQL catalogs. Baseline for design review, not a restorable backup or a migration.
column_notation: name type; ! means NOT NULL, ? means nullable; = precedes a default. IDENTITY marks a server-generated key. PostgreSQL type aliases are retained.
privilege_scope: These tested table privileges are the same on all 21 tables. Provider API exposure and user sessions were not tested.

tables.name: public.audit_logs
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
enabled_user_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_logs_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.audit_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_prevent_log_mutation()

tables.name: public.batches
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(department_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.conflict_log
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (schedule_id) REFERENCES schedules(schedule_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.constraint_rules
constraints: CHECK ((NOT (((rule_code)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['H01'::character varying, 'H02'::character varying, 'H03'::character varying, 'H08'::character varying, 'E01'::character varying, 'E04'::character varying, 'E05'::character varying])::text[])) AND (is_enabled = false))))
FOREIGN KEY (config_id) REFERENCES scheduling_configs(config_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.course_offerings
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES batches(batch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses(course_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (instructor_id) REFERENCES instructors(instructor_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (term_id) REFERENCES academic_terms(term_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.courses
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(department_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.enrollments
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (offering_id) REFERENCES course_offerings(offering_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.exam_entries
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses(course_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (exam_slot_id) REFERENCES exam_slots(exam_slot_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (schedule_id) REFERENCES schedules(schedule_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
enabled_user_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_exam_entries_protect_published BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.exam_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_prevent_published_schedule_entry_edit()

tables.name: public.exam_room_allocations
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (exam_entry_id) REFERENCES exam_entries(exam_entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES rooms(room_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
enabled_user_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_exam_allocations_protect_published BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.exam_room_allocations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_prevent_published_schedule_entry_edit()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_exam_room_allocations_capacity BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.exam_room_allocations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_check_exam_room_capacity()

tables.name: public.exam_slots
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (term_id) REFERENCES academic_terms(term_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
enabled_user_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_exam_slots_no_overlap BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.exam_slots FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_check_exam_slot_overlap()

tables.name: public.import_logs
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
enabled_user_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_import_logs_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.import_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_prevent_log_mutation()

tables.name: public.instructor_availability
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (instructor_id) REFERENCES instructors(instructor_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (slot_id) REFERENCES time_slots(slot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.instructors
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(department_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.rooms
constraints: CHECK (((room_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Lecture'::character varying, 'Lab'::character varying, 'Exam Hall'::character varying])::text[])))

tables.name: public.schedules
constraints: CHECK (((solver_status IS NULL) OR ((solver_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['optimal'::character varying, 'feasible'::character varying, 'infeasible'::character varying, 'unknown'::character varying, 'interrupted'::character varying])::text[]))))

CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Draft'::character varying, 'Generating'::character varying, 'Infeasible'::character varying, 'Generated'::character varying, 'Published'::character varying, 'Archived'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (approved_by) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (config_id) REFERENCES scheduling_configs(config_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (generated_by) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (term_id) REFERENCES academic_terms(term_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.scheduling_configs
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (term_id) REFERENCES academic_terms(term_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.time_slots
constraints: CHECK (((NOT is_blocked) OR ((block_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM block_reason)) > 0))))
FOREIGN KEY (term_id) REFERENCES academic_terms(term_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: public.timetable_entries
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (offering_id, instructor_id, batch_id) REFERENCES course_offerings(offering_id, instructor_id, batch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES batches(batch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (instructor_id) REFERENCES instructors(instructor_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (offering_id) REFERENCES course_offerings(offering_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES rooms(room_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (schedule_id) REFERENCES schedules(schedule_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (slot_id) REFERENCES time_slots(slot_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
enabled_user_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER trg_timetable_entries_protect_published BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.timetable_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_prevent_published_schedule_entry_edit()

tables.name: public.users
constraints: CHECK (((role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Administrator'::character varying, 'Coordinator'::character varying, 'Approver'::character varying, 'Faculty'::character varying, 'Student'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES batches(batch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (instructor_id) REFERENCES instructors(instructor_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

partial_unique_indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_academic_terms_single_active ON public.academic_terms USING btree (status) WHERE ((status)::text = 'Active'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_schedules_one_published_per_term_type ON public.schedules USING btree (term_id, schedule_type) WHERE ((status)::text = 'Published'::text)

fn_check_exam_slot_overlap

fn_seed_default_constraint_rules
public_functions.definition:
DECLARE
    v_schedule_type VARCHAR(10);
BEGIN
    SELECT schedule_type INTO v_schedule_type
    FROM scheduling_configs
    WHERE config_id = p_config_id;

    IF v_schedule_type = 'Timetable' THEN
        INSERT INTO constraint_rules (config_id, rule_code, rule_type, is_enabled, weight, param_value)
        VALUES
            (p_config_id, 'H01', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H02', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H03', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H04', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H05', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H06', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H07', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H08', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H09', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'H10', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'S01', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'S02', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'S03', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, 5),
            (p_config_id, 'S04', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, 3),
            (p_config_id, 'S05', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'S06', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, NULL)
        ON CONFLICT (config_id, rule_code) DO NOTHING;
    ELSIF v_schedule_type = 'Exam' THEN
        INSERT INTO constraint_rules (config_id, rule_code, rule_type, is_enabled, weight, param_value)
        VALUES
            (p_config_id, 'E01', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'E02', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, 2),
            (p_config_id, 'E03', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'E04', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'E05', 'Hard', TRUE, 0, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'ES01', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'ES02', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, NULL),
            (p_config_id, 'ES03', 'Soft', TRUE, 5, NULL)
        ON CONFLICT (config_id, rule_code) DO NOTHING;
    END IF;
END;
